entities.summary: Henrik Gabriel "Heikki" Renvall was a Finnish lawyer, journalist and the Head of the Editorial Board at the Finnish Ministry of Trade and Industry from 1917–1918. He married opera singer Aino Ackté, and their daughter was Glory Leppänen.
